title: ASUS scraper: board names contain raw HTML tags (e.g. h2 tags)
description:
Steps to reproduce: 1. Expected: Actual: The ASUS SeriesFilterResult API returns board names with HTML markup. _fetch_boards_for_socket stores them verbatim into BoardInfo.model (asus.py:129). Observed output from psp-etl scrape asus:

TUF GAMING X670E-PLUS WIFI

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 100% The HTML bleeds into progress bar labels, stored model values in the database, and exported filenames. Fix: strip HTML tags from the board name in _fetch_boards_for_socket before constructing BoardInfo. Acceptance criteria: - BoardInfo.model contains plain text (no HTML tags) - Existing scraper unit tests still pass - New test: _fetch_boards_for_socket with an API response containing

NAME

=> BoardInfo.model == 'NAME'
